scenario: YouTube 规模下,不到 1% 的用户会去点赞/踩,显式反馈既稀疏又偏向有强烈意见的人。
scenario_en: At YouTube scale, under 1% of users ever tap thumbs up/down, so explicit feedback is both sparse and biased toward strong opinions.
q: 为什么视频推荐主要靠隐式反馈而非显式反馈来学习？
q_en: Why does video recommendation learn mainly from implicit rather than explicit feedback?
why: 显式反馈(赞/踩)只有 <1% 用户给,稀疏且偏向强意见人群,覆盖不了大多数用户。所以要从用户「做了什么」(看多久、重看、跳过、分享)这些隐式信号学习——它们海量、覆盖全、更能代表真实偏好。
why_en: Explicit feedback (likes/dislikes) comes from under 1% of users, sparse and skewed to strong opinions, so you learn from what users do — watch time, replays, skips, shares — which are abundant, cover everyone, and better represent real preference.
options: 隐式反馈稀疏、显式反馈充足,所以主要用显式
显式反馈 <1% 用户给、稀疏且偏强意见;隐式信号(看/重看/跳/分享)海量覆盖全,更代表真实偏好
两者都不用,直接让人工逐条打标
只用显式反馈,忽略所有观看行为
options_en: Implicit feedback is sparse and explicit is abundant, so use explicit mainly.
Explicit comes from under 1% of users, sparse and strong-opinion-biased; implicit signals (watch/replay/skip/share) are abundant, cover everyone, and better represent real preference.
Use neither; have humans hand-label every item.
Use only explicit feedback, ignoring all watch behavior.
optionExplanations: 说反了:显式(赞/踩)才稀疏,隐式(观看行为)才海量,主要靠隐式。
对;显式稀疏偏置、隐式海量代表真实,这是数据策略的出发点。
人工逐条打标在数十亿量级不可行,也无法实时。
只用显式会丢掉 99% 用户的行为信号,严重欠拟合真实偏好。
optionExplanations_en: Backwards: explicit (likes/dislikes) is the sparse one and implicit (watch behavior) is abundant, so rely on implicit.
Correct — explicit is sparse and biased while implicit is abundant and representative, the starting point of the data strategy.
Hand-labeling every item is infeasible at billions scale and not real-time.
Explicit-only discards the behavior of 99% of users, badly underfitting real preference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从用户行为(观看时长、重看、跳过、分享)推断偏好,而非直接问用户。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Implicit feedback infers preference from user behavior (watch time, replays, skips, shares) rather than asking directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户主动给的评价(赞/踩/评分),稀疏且偏向有强意见者。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Explicit feedback is ratings users actively give (like/dislike/score), sparse and biased toward strong opinions.

scenario: 你要用几种隐式信号一起代理「用户满意度」,每种信号刻画的是不同侧面。
scenario_en: You proxy user satisfaction with several implicit signals, each capturing a different facet.
q: 哪些是常用的隐式满意度信号，各代理什么？(多选)
q_en: Which are common implicit satisfaction signals, and what does each proxy? (multiple)
why: 四个核心信号各刻画一面:观看时长=参与深度、重看(replay)=重温意愿(very strong)、跳过(skip)=不感兴趣、分享(share)=社交背书(最强)。多信号互补,单一信号都有噪声与偏差。
why_en: Four core signals each capture a facet: watch time is engagement depth, replays are rewatch intent (very strong), skips are disinterest, and shares are social endorsement (strongest) — complementary because any single one has noise and bias.
options: 观看时长——参与深度
重看(replay)——重温意愿;分享(share)——社交背书(最强)
跳过(skip)——不感兴趣
视频文件的编码码率——用户满意度
options_en: Watch time — engagement depth.
Replays — rewatch intent; shares — social endorsement (strongest).
Skips — disinterest.
The video's encoding bitrate — user satisfaction.
optionExplanations: 对;观看时长代理参与深度,是最基础的隐式信号。
对;重看=强重温意愿,分享=最强的社交背书信号。
对;跳过代理不感兴趣,是重要的负向隐式信号。
错;码率是画质参数,与用户是否满意无关。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — watch time proxies engagement depth, the most basic implicit signal.
Correct — replays are strong rewatch intent and shares are the strongest social-endorsement signal.
Correct — skips proxy disinterest, an important negative implicit signal.
Wrong — bitrate is a video-quality parameter, unrelated to user satisfaction.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户重复观看同一视频,代理很强的重温意愿,但信号稀疏。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A replay is rewatching the same video, proxying strong rewatch intent but a sparse signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户把视频转发给他人,是最强的社交背书满意度信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A share is forwarding a video to others, the strongest social-endorsement satisfaction signal.

scenario: 直接用绝对观看时长当标签,模型偏爱长视频:看 2 小时电影的 10% 也有 12 分钟,远超看完一个 30 秒短片。
scenario_en: Using absolute watch time as the label makes the model favor long videos: 10% of a 2-hour movie is 12 minutes, far more than fully watching a 30-second clip.
q: 该怎么处理观看时长这个信号，为什么？
q_en: How should you treat the watch-time signal, and why?
why: 按视频时长归一化成完成率(completion rate):看完 30 秒的 95% 比只看 2 小时电影的 10% 更能说明满意。绝对时长偏向长视频、混入内容长度这个混杂因素,归一化才让不同长度的视频可比。
why_en: Normalize by video duration into a completion rate: watching 95% of a 30-second clip signals more satisfaction than 10% of a 2-hour movie, since absolute time favors long videos and confounds length, while completion rate makes different lengths comparable.
tradeoff: 完成率(消除长度混杂、可比) vs 绝对时长(偏向长视频、被内容长度污染)
options: 直接用绝对观看时长,越长越好
按时长归一化成完成率:95% 的 30 秒 > 10% 的 2 小时,消除长度混杂让不同长度可比
只看是否点开,不看看多久
把观看时长取对数后再乘以文件大小
options_en: Use absolute watch time directly; the longer the better.
Normalize by duration into a completion rate: 95% of a 30s clip > 10% of a 2h movie, removing the length confound to compare across durations.
Only whether it was opened, not how long.
Take the log of watch time and multiply by file size.
whenOtherWins: 若产品就是要奖励长时长沉浸(如长播客/直播),绝对时长本身就是目标,这时不必强行归一成完成率。
whenOtherWins_en: If the product intends to reward long immersion (long podcasts/livestreams), absolute time is itself the goal and you need not force it into a completion rate.
optionExplanations: 绝对时长偏向长视频,把内容长度这个混杂当成偏好,系统会一味推长视频。
对;完成率把不同长度拉到同一尺度,才能公平比较满意度。
只看是否点开丢掉了参与深度,连长度混杂问题都没解决。
乘文件大小引入无关变量,反而制造新的偏差,毫无依据。
optionExplanations_en: Absolute time favors long videos, mistaking the length confound for preference, so the system just pushes long videos.
Correct — completion rate puts different lengths on one scale for a fair satisfaction comparison.
Only whether opened drops engagement depth and does not even address the length confound.
Multiplying by file size introduces an irrelevant variable and creates new bias with no basis.

termDefinitions.meaning: 观看时长占视频总时长的比例,归一化后不同长度视频可比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Completion rate is watch time as a fraction of total video duration, normalizing so different-length videos are comparable.

scenario: 用户把视频放着当背景音、人却去干别的,系统记录到很长的观看时长。
scenario_en: A user leaves a video playing as background audio while doing something else, and the system logs a long watch time.
q: 这暴露了隐式信号的什么问题，属于哪类错误？
q_en: What implicit-signal problem does this expose, and which error type?
why: 这是背景播放导致的假阳性(false positive):长观看时长其实不代表满意。隐式信号普遍有噪声且相互关联——另一例是「已看过的视频被跳过」是假阴性(false negative)。所以要多信号交叉、并对背景播放等模式去偏。
why_en: This is a background-play false positive: long watch time does not actually mean satisfaction, and implicit signals are generally noisy and correlated (an already-watched skip is a false negative), so cross-check multiple signals and de-bias patterns like background play.
options: 背景播放假阳性:长时长≠满意;隐式信号普遍有噪声,需多信号交叉+对背景播放去偏
说明观看时长是完美无偏信号,可单独使用
属于概念漂移,与信号噪声无关
是硬件录制错误,重启服务即可
options_en: Background-play false positive: long time is not satisfaction; implicit signals are noisy, needing multi-signal cross-checks and de-biasing.
It shows watch time is a perfectly unbiased signal usable alone.
It is concept drift, unrelated to signal noise.
A hardware recording error, fixed by restarting the service.
optionExplanations: 对;背景播放让长时长变成假阳性,正说明单一隐式信号有噪声,需交叉验证与去偏。
背景播放恰恰证明观看时长有偏,不能单独当满意度真值。
这是信号噪声/假阳性,不是输入到标签映射变化的概念漂移。
记录本身没错,错在把背景播放的长时长误读为满意,不是硬件问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — background play turns long time into a false positive, showing a single implicit signal is noisy and needs cross-checks and de-biasing.
Background play is exactly why watch time is biased and cannot be used alone as satisfaction ground truth.
This is signal noise / a false positive, not concept drift (a changed input-to-label mapping).
The recording is correct; the error is misreading long background-play time as satisfaction, not a hardware fault.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把非满意行为(背景播放的长时长)误当成满意信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false positive is mistaking a non-satisfaction behavior (long background-play time) for a satisfaction signal.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把非不满行为(跳过已看过的视频)误当成负信号。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A false negative is mistaking a non-dislike behavior (skipping an already-watched video) for a negative signal.

scenario: 两个跳过:一个是视频刚开头几秒就被跳,一个是看了大半才放弃。
scenario_en: Two skips: one in the first few seconds, one after watching most of it.
q: 早跳和晚弃的负向信号强度一样吗，为什么？
q_en: Do early skip and late abandonment carry the same negative weight, and why?
why: 不一样:开头几秒就跳,负向信号更强——用户几乎没给内容机会,基本是明确不感兴趣;看了大半才弃,负向弱得多——已经获得不少价值。建模时应给早跳更大的负权重。
why_en: No: an early skip in the first few seconds carries a stronger negative signal (the user barely gave it a chance, near-clear disinterest), while late abandonment is much weaker since they already got value, so weight early skips more negatively.
options: 一样,只要是跳过就同等负向
不一样:早跳负向更强(几乎没给机会),晚弃负向弱(已获价值);早跳应给更大负权重
晚弃负向更强,因为看得久说明更失望
跳过一律是正信号,代表快速找到下一个
options_en: Same; any skip is equally negative.
Different: early skip is stronger negative (barely gave it a chance), late abandonment weaker (already got value); weight early skips more negatively.
Late abandonment is stronger because watching long means more disappointment.
Skips are always positive, meaning quickly finding the next one.
optionExplanations: 把早跳和晚弃同等对待,抹掉了「给没给内容机会」这个关键差异。
对;早跳几乎没给机会是强负向,晚弃已获价值是弱负向,权重应有别。
看得久通常说明获得了价值,晚弃负向反而更弱,说反了。
跳过是负信号不是正信号,把它当正向会误导训练。
optionExplanations_en: Treating early skip and late abandonment equally erases the key difference of whether the content got a chance.
Correct — an early skip barely gave it a chance (strong negative) while late abandonment already got value (weak negative), so weights should differ.
Watching long usually means value was gained, so late abandonment is a weaker negative — backwards.
A skip is a negative signal, not positive, and treating it as positive misleads training.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户放弃当前视频转下一个;早跳负向强、晚弃负向弱。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A skip is abandoning the current video for the next; early skips are strongly negative, late abandonment weakly so.

scenario: 有了观看时长、重看、跳过、分享四个信号,你要把它们合成模型能优化的训练标签。
scenario_en: With watch time, replays, skips, and shares in hand, you must combine them into a trainable label.
q: 把多个隐式信号合成标签，「加权求和」与「多任务学习」的核心区别是什么？
q_en: Combining multiple implicit signals, what is the core difference between a weighted sum and multi-task learning?
why: 加权求和把多信号压成一个标量标签,简单但要手调权重、且抹掉了各信号语义;多任务学习给每个信号一个预测头、共享底座 backbone,保留各信号语义又共享表征。YouTube/TikTok 标准是多任务。
why_en: A weighted sum compresses signals into one scalar label — simple but needs hand-tuned weights and erases each signal's semantics — while multi-task learning gives each signal its own head over a shared backbone, keeping semantics while sharing representations; YouTube/TikTok default to multi-task.
tradeoff: 加权求和(单标量、简单但抹语义/需调权重) vs 多任务(多头共享底座、保语义但更复杂)

rows: 更复杂, 需平衡各头

options: 两者等价,只是命名不同
加权求和=多信号压成单标量(简单但抹语义/需调权重);多任务=每信号一头共享 backbone(保语义)
加权求和需要多个预测头,多任务只输出一个标量
多任务学习不能共享参数,每个信号完全独立训练
options_en: They are equivalent, just named differently.
Weighted sum compresses signals into one scalar (simple but erases semantics/needs tuning); multi-task gives each signal a head over a shared backbone (keeps semantics).
Weighted sum needs multiple heads; multi-task outputs a single scalar.
Multi-task learning cannot share parameters; each signal trains fully independently.
optionExplanations: 两者机制不同:一个压标量一个多头,输出和可维护性都不一样,不等价。
对;单标量 vs 多头共享底座是二者的本质区别,后者保留信号语义。
说反了:加权求和才是单标量,多任务才用多个头。
多任务的核心正是共享 backbone,不是完全独立训练。
optionExplanations_en: The mechanisms differ: one compresses to a scalar, one uses multiple heads, with different outputs and maintainability — not equivalent.
Correct — single scalar vs multi-head over a shared backbone is the essential difference, the latter preserving signal semantics.
Backwards: the weighted sum is the single scalar and multi-task uses multiple heads.
Multi-task's essence is a shared backbone, not fully independent training.

termDefinitions.term: weighted sum label / 加权求和标签
termDefinitions.meaning: 把多个信号按权重加成一个标量标签,简单但需人工调权重、丢失各信号语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A weighted-sum label combines signals by weights into one scalar, simple but needing hand-tuned weights and losing per-signal semantics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 共享一个底座 backbone、为每个信号设独立预测头,保留各信号语义又共享表征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multi-task learning shares one backbone with a separate head per signal, keeping each signal's semantics while sharing representations.

scenario: 你想让模型同时兼顾观看时长、跳过、分享等信号,又不想手调一个脆弱的加权系数,还要在各信号间共享学到的表征。
scenario_en: You want the model to honor watch time, skips, shares at once without hand-tuning a brittle weight, while sharing learned representations across signals.
q: YouTube/TikTok 规模下的标准做法是什么，好处是什么？
q_en: What is the standard approach at YouTube/TikTok scale, and its benefit?
why: 标准是多任务学习:一个共享 backbone 学通用表征,每个信号挂一个预测头,既尊重每个信号的语义、又让它们共享底层特征。比加权求和更稳,不用手调一个把所有信号糊在一起的权重。
why_en: The standard is multi-task learning: a shared backbone learns general representations with one head per signal, respecting each signal's semantics while sharing lower-level features — more robust than a weighted sum and free of hand-tuning one blended weight.
tradeoff: 多任务(共享表征+保语义,YouTube/TikTok 标准) vs 加权求和(单标量,需手调、抹语义)
options: 只训一个观看时长的单一模型,其他信号丢掉
多任务学习:共享 backbone+每信号一头,保各信号语义又共享表征,免手调加权
给每个信号各训一个完全独立的模型,serving 时投票
把所有信号硬编码成 if-else 规则
options_en: Train a single watch-time model and drop the other signals.
Multi-task learning: shared backbone plus one head per signal, keeping semantics while sharing representations and avoiding hand-tuned weights.
Train a fully independent model per signal and vote at serving.
Hard-code all signals into if-else rules.
whenOtherWins: 若信号很少、语义高度一致,一个精调的加权求和单标量更简单够用,不必上多任务的复杂度。
whenOtherWins_en: If signals are few and highly aligned in semantics, a well-tuned weighted-sum scalar is simpler and sufficient, without multi-task complexity.
optionExplanations: 只训观看时长丢了跳过/分享等互补信号,欠拟合真实满意度。
对;多任务是 YouTube/TikTok 标准,共享表征+保语义,兼顾稳健与效果。
各训独立模型无法共享表征,还要维护多套,serving 投票也更贵。
if-else 规则学不到细粒度偏好,扛不住规模,是倒退。
optionExplanations_en: Training only watch time drops complementary skip/share signals, underfitting real satisfaction.
Correct — multi-task is the YouTube/TikTok standard, sharing representations and keeping semantics for both robustness and quality.
Independent models cannot share representations, need multiple pipelines, and voting at serving is costlier.
If-else rules cannot learn fine-grained preference and do not scale, a regression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多任务模型中被各预测头共用的底层网络,学通用表征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A backbone is the shared lower network used by all heads in a multi-task model, learning general representations.

scenario: 你要为模型设计「用户特征」——刻画这个用户是谁、长期偏好如何。
scenario_en: You design user features — who the user is and their long-term preferences.
q: 哪些属于用户特征，它们的时间尺度是怎样的？
q_en: Which are user features, and what is their time scale?
why: 用户特征刻画长期、稳定的画像:近 30 天的品类分布、平均会话时长、时段活跃曲线、人口属性(年龄段/语言/国家)、7 天累计观看/跳过/分享率。它们变化慢,可批量更新。
why_en: User features capture a long-term, stable profile: 30-day genre distribution, average session length, time-of-day activity curves, demographics (age bucket/language/country), and 7-day cumulative watch/skip/share rates — slow-changing, batch-updatable.
tradeoff: 用户特征(长期稳定、可批量更新) vs 上下文特征(短期意图、需近实时)
options: 当前设备类型和此刻时段,属短期意图
近 30 天品类分布、平均会话时长、人口属性、7 天累计观看/跳过/分享率,长期稳定可批量更新
视频的标题和时长
当前会话最近看的 N 个视频
options_en: Current device type and current time-of-day, a short-term intent.
30-day genre distribution, average session length, demographics, 7-day cumulative watch/skip/share rates — long-term stable, batch-updatable.
The video's title and duration.
The last N videos in the current session.
whenOtherWins: 若要捕捉「这一刻想看什么」的临时意图,那是上下文特征(设备/时段/本会话最近视频),而非长期用户画像。
whenOtherWins_en: To capture right-now intent, use contextual features (device/time/last videos this session), not the long-term user profile.
optionExplanations: 设备/此刻时段是上下文特征、刻画短期意图,不是长期用户画像。
对;这些都是慢变、长期稳定的用户画像特征,可批量更新。
标题和时长是视频特征,描述被打分的物品,不是用户。
本会话最近视频是上下文特征,刻画即时意图,不是长期画像。
optionExplanations_en: Device/current time are contextual features capturing short-term intent, not a long-term user profile.
Correct — these are slow-changing, long-term stable user-profile features, batch-updatable.
Title and duration are video features describing the scored item, not the user.
Last videos this session are contextual features for immediate intent, not a long-term profile.

termDefinitions.meaning: 刻画用户长期身份与偏好的特征(历史品类分布、人口属性等),变化慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: User features capture a user's long-term identity and preferences (historical genre distribution, demographics), changing slowly.

scenario: 同一个用户,早上 8 点在手机上通勤,和晚上 9 点在客厅智能电视上,看到的推荐很不一样。
scenario_en: The same user at 8AM on a phone commuting versus 9PM on a living-room smart TV gets very different recommendations.
q: 是什么类型的特征造成了同一用户不同时刻的推荐差异？
q_en: Which feature type causes the same user to get different recs at different moments?
why: 上下文特征:当前设备(手机通勤→偏短视频;智能电视晚间→偏长视频)、时段、星期几、本会话最近看的 N 个视频。它们刻画「此刻的即时意图」,是同一用户在不同情境拿到不同推荐的原因。面试官特别看重这一区分。
why_en: Contextual features: current device (phone commute favors short-form, evening smart-TV favors long-form), time of day, day of week, and the last N videos this session — they capture right-now intent and are why the same user gets different recs across contexts.
tradeoff: 上下文特征(即时意图、需近实时更新) vs 用户特征(长期画像、批量更新)
options: 用户长期人口属性,如年龄段和国家
上下文特征:当前设备/时段/星期几/本会话最近视频,刻画此刻即时意图
视频的创作者 ID 和上传时间
视频的内容嵌入向量
options_en: Long-term demographics like age bucket and country.
Contextual features: current device/time/day-of-week/last videos this session, capturing right-now intent.
The video's creator ID and upload date.
The video's content embedding vector.
whenOtherWins: 若要解释这个用户「一贯」的口味(跨情境稳定的偏好),那看长期用户特征而非上下文特征。
whenOtherWins_en: To explain the user's habitual taste (stable across contexts), look at long-term user features rather than contextual ones.
optionExplanations: 人口属性是长期用户特征、跨情境稳定,解释不了同一用户不同时刻的差异。
对;设备/时段/本会话视频等上下文特征刻画即时意图,正是差异来源。
创作者 ID/上传时间是视频特征,描述物品不描述情境。
内容嵌入是视频特征,刻画视频语义,不刻画用户此刻情境。
optionExplanations_en: Demographics are long-term user features stable across contexts and cannot explain moment-to-moment differences.
Correct — contextual features like device/time/session videos capture immediate intent, the source of the difference.
Creator ID/upload date are video features describing the item, not the context.
Content embeddings are video features capturing video semantics, not the user's current context.

termDefinitions.meaning: 当前请求的即时情境(设备、时段、星期、本会话最近视频),刻画短期意图。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Contextual features are the current request's immediate context (device, time, day, recent session videos), capturing short-term intent.

scenario: 模型吃的是一个结构化特征向量,而不是原始行为流;这些特征沿三个维度组织。
scenario_en: The model consumes a structured feature vector, not raw behavior; features organize along three dimensions.
q: 视频推荐的特征工程通常沿哪三个维度组织？
q_en: Along which three dimensions is video-recommendation feature engineering organized?
why: 三维:用户特征(用户是谁+长期历史)、视频特征(被打分的物品:元数据+人气+内容嵌入)、上下文特征(当前请求的即时情境)。三者分别贡献长期画像、物品属性、短期意图,缺一面推荐就偏。
why_en: Three dimensions: user features (who + long-term history), video features (the scored item: metadata + popularity + content embeddings), and contextual features (the current request's immediate context) — contributing long-term profile, item attributes, and short-term intent.
options: 训练集/验证集/测试集三维
用户特征、视频特征、上下文特征:长期画像+物品属性+短期意图
CPU/内存/磁盘三维
召回/排序/重排三维
options_en: Train/validation/test three splits.
User features, video features, contextual features: long-term profile + item attributes + short-term intent.
CPU/memory/disk three dimensions.
Retrieval/ranking/re-ranking three stages.
optionExplanations: 训练/验证/测试是数据划分,不是特征工程的维度。
对;用户/视频/上下文三维分别覆盖长期画像、物品属性、即时意图。
CPU/内存/磁盘是硬件资源,不是特征维度。
召回/排序/重排是流程阶段,不是特征组织维度。
optionExplanations_en: Train/validation/test are data splits, not feature-engineering dimensions.
Correct — user/video/context cover long-term profile, item attributes, and immediate intent.
CPU/memory/disk are hardware resources, not feature dimensions.
Retrieval/ranking/re-ranking are pipeline stages, not feature-organization dimensions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被打分物品的属性:标题/类别/时长/创作者、人气统计、内容嵌入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Video features are the scored item's attributes: title/category/duration/creator, popularity stats, and content embeddings.

scenario: 两类特征更新节奏差别很大:本会话最近看了什么(几秒前发生),和某视频的总播放量/人气(慢慢累积)。
scenario_en: Two feature classes differ in update cadence: what the user watched this session (seconds ago) and a video's total views/popularity (slowly accruing).
q: 特征的「新鲜度谱系」该怎么塑造特征存储的选型？
q_en: How should the feature freshness spectrum shape the feature-store choice?
why: 按新鲜度分层存储:本会话/即时信号需近实时更新,放内存型存储(如 Redis)秒级可读;人气统计变化慢,可由离线管线每几小时批量更新。用一套统一存储硬扛两端,要么太贵要么不够新鲜。
why_en: Tier storage by freshness: current-session/immediate signals need near-real-time updates in an in-memory store (Redis) readable in seconds, while slow popularity stats can batch-update every few hours from offline pipelines — one uniform store for both is either too costly or too stale.
tradeoff: 内存近实时(会话信号、快但贵) vs 批量每几小时(人气统计、省但滞后)
options: 所有特征都放同一个每天更新一次的离线表
按新鲜度分层:会话即时信号用内存(Redis)近实时,人气统计用离线管线每几小时批量
所有特征都放内存并毫秒级更新,不计成本
全部特征只在模型训练时算,serving 不更新
options_en: Put all features in one offline table refreshed once a day.
Tier by freshness: session/immediate signals in memory (Redis) near-real-time, popularity stats batch-updated every few hours from offline pipelines.
Put all features in memory with millisecond updates regardless of cost.
Compute all features only at training time and never update at serving.
whenOtherWins: 若某个人气类特征其实需要秒级新鲜(如实时热榜),就把它也提升到内存近实时层,新鲜度需求而非默认分层决定归属。
whenOtherWins_en: If a popularity feature actually needs second-level freshness (a live trending chart), promote it to the in-memory near-real-time tier — the freshness need, not the default tier, decides.
optionExplanations: 统一每天更新会让会话即时信号严重过期,推荐跟不上当下意图。
对;按新鲜度分层把即时信号放内存、人气放批量,兼顾新鲜与成本。
全部内存毫秒更新对慢变人气是浪费,成本失控且无必要。
serving 不更新等于用陈旧特征,即时意图完全捕捉不到。
optionExplanations_en: One daily refresh leaves session-immediate signals badly stale, so recs cannot track current intent.
Correct — tiering by freshness puts immediate signals in memory and popularity in batch, balancing freshness and cost.
All-in-memory millisecond updates waste resources on slow popularity, blowing cost with no need.
Not updating at serving means stale features, missing immediate intent entirely.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同特征对更新时效的要求不同,从秒级(会话)到几小时(人气),决定存储分层。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The freshness spectrum is how different features need different update timeliness, from seconds (session) to hours (popularity), driving storage tiering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 内存键值存储,读延迟约毫秒级,用于近实时的会话/即时特征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis is an in-memory key-value store with millisecond read latency, used for near-real-time session/immediate features.

scenario: 一个刚上传 5 分钟的新视频:0 观看时长、0 重看、0 分享,没有任何用户互动历史。
scenario_en: A brand-new video uploaded 5 minutes ago: zero watch time, zero replays, zero shares, no interaction history.
q: 新视频为什么会陷入冷启动的「先有鸡还是先有蛋」死锁？
q_en: Why does a new video hit the cold-start chicken-and-egg deadlock?
why: 协同过滤靠「看过 X 的人也看 Y」的互动共现,新视频零互动就没有共现数据→无法被 CF 推荐→没曝光→更收不到互动,形成先有鸡先有蛋的死锁。必须用不依赖互动历史的信号(内容嵌入)破局。
why_en: Collaborative filtering relies on interaction co-occurrence (people who watched X also watched Y), but a zero-interaction new video has no co-occurrence, so CF cannot recommend it, it gets no exposure, receives no interactions, and deadlocks — broken only by an interaction-free signal like content embeddings.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  N["新视频 0 互动"] --> NC["无共现数据"]
  NC --> NR["CF 无法推荐"]
  NR --> NE["无曝光"]
  NE --> N
options: 因为新视频文件太大,存储不下
CF 靠互动共现,新视频零互动→无共现→CF 推不了→无曝光→更无互动,先有鸡先有蛋死锁
因为新视频还没被转码完成
因为新视频缺少标题,无法索引
options_en: Because the new video file is too large to store.
CF relies on interaction co-occurrence; zero interactions means no co-occurrence, so CF cannot recommend it, no exposure, no interactions — a chicken-and-egg deadlock.
Because the new video is not finished transcoding.
Because the new video lacks a title and cannot be indexed.
optionExplanations: 冷启动是数据(零互动)问题,不是文件大小或存储问题。
对;零互动→无共现→CF 无从下手→无曝光→仍无互动,正是冷启动死锁的机制。
转码是工程步骤,与 CF 需要互动共现的死锁无关。
标题缺失可补,冷启动的根本是缺互动共现数据,不是缺标题。
optionExplanations_en: Cold start is a data (zero-interaction) problem, not a file-size or storage issue.
Correct — zero interactions means no co-occurrence, so CF has nothing to work with, no exposure, still no interactions — the cold-start deadlock mechanism.
Transcoding is an engineering step, unrelated to the CF-needs-co-occurrence deadlock.
A missing title can be added; cold start's root is missing interaction co-occurrence, not a missing title.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新视频/新用户零互动历史,协同过滤无从推荐,形成先有鸡先有蛋死锁。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is a new video/user with no interaction history, so collaborative filtering cannot recommend it, forming a chicken-and-egg deadlock.

scenario: 一个上线才 5 分钟、零互动的新视频,你要让它有机会进入某些用户的候选检索集。
scenario_en: A 5-minute-old, zero-engagement new video needs a chance to enter some users' candidate retrieval set.
q: 怎么把这个新视频 bootstrap 进检索集，最合适？
q_en: How do you best bootstrap this new video into the retrieval set?
why: 用内容嵌入:预训练模型从视觉帧/音频/标题描述提出一个语义向量,新烹饪教程即使零互动也会落在已有烹饪视频附近。用它和用户偏好嵌入做 ANN 相似度检索,超过阈值就进候选集,绕开对互动历史的依赖。
why_en: Use a content embedding: a pretrained model turns visual frames/audio/title-description into a semantic vector, so a new cooking tutorial lands near existing cooking videos despite zero interactions, and ANN similarity against user-preference embeddings admits it to the set above a threshold.
tradeoff: 内容嵌入 bootstrap(零互动也可推、但个性化弱) vs 只等 CF(需先攒互动、新视频永远起不来)
options: 等它自然攒够互动再让 CF 推荐,期间不推
用内容嵌入(视觉/音频/文本)把它放到语义相近视频附近,再用 ANN 相似度进候选集
随机把它插进所有用户的候选集
只按上传时间新旧强行置顶
options_en: Wait until it naturally accrues enough interactions for CF, not recommending it meanwhile.
Use a content embedding (visual/audio/text) to place it near semantically similar videos, then ANN similarity to enter the candidate set.
Randomly insert it into every user's candidate set.
Force it to the top purely by upload recency.
whenOtherWins: 若视频已积累了足够互动,协同过滤嵌入通常比内容嵌入更个性化、更准,这时应逐步转向 CF。
whenOtherWins_en: Once a video has accrued enough interactions, collaborative-filtering embeddings are usually more personalized and accurate, so shift toward CF.
optionExplanations: 干等互动正是死锁本身:不推就永远收不到互动,新视频永远起不来。
对;内容嵌入不依赖互动历史,用语义相似度破解冷启动死锁,是标准解法。
随机插入无关内容会伤体验,也不是基于语义相关的 bootstrap。
只按新旧置顶不考虑相关性,会把不相关新视频塞给所有人。
optionExplanations_en: Waiting for interactions is the deadlock itself: no exposure means no interactions ever, so the video never takes off.
Correct — content embeddings need no interaction history and use semantic similarity to break the cold-start deadlock, the standard fix.
Randomly inserting irrelevant content hurts experience and is not semantically relevant bootstrapping.
Top-pinning by recency ignores relevance and forces irrelevant new videos on everyone.

termDefinitions.meaning: 从视频的视觉/音频/文本内容提取的语义向量,不依赖互动历史,用于冷启动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A content embedding is a semantic vector from a video's visual/audio/text content, independent of interaction history, used for cold start.

scenario: 要给新视频生成一个不依赖任何观看历史的语义向量。
scenario_en: You need a semantic vector for a new video that depends on no watch history.
q: 内容嵌入通常从视频的哪些模态、用什么模型生成？
q_en: From which modalities and models is a content embedding typically generated?
why: 多模态提取:视觉 transformer 编码画面帧、音频编码器编码原声、文本编码器编码标题/描述,融合成一个稠密语义向量。它捕捉「视频讲的是什么」,靠内容而非互动定位,让新视频一上线就能落到语义邻域。
why_en: Multimodal extraction: a vision transformer encodes frames, an audio encoder the soundtrack, and a text encoder the title/description, fused into a dense semantic vector capturing what the video is about, positioning it by content rather than interaction.
options: 只从观看时长和分享数生成,属互动信号
视觉 transformer 编码帧 + 音频编码器编码原声 + 文本编码器编码标题/描述,融合成语义向量
从视频文件的字节流直接哈希生成
从上传者的粉丝数换算得到
options_en: Only from watch time and share count, an interaction signal.
A vision transformer encodes frames + an audio encoder the soundtrack + a text encoder the title/description, fused into a semantic vector.
Directly hashed from the video file's byte stream.
Derived from the uploader's follower count.
optionExplanations: 观看时长/分享是互动信号,新视频恰恰没有,这不是内容嵌入的来源。
对;视觉/音频/文本三模态编码融合,是不依赖互动的内容嵌入标准做法。
字节流哈希不含语义,相似内容的视频不会靠近,无法用于语义检索。
粉丝数是创作者人气,不刻画视频内容语义。
optionExplanations_en: Watch time/shares are interaction signals a new video lacks, not the source of a content embedding.
Correct — fusing vision/audio/text encoders is the standard interaction-free content-embedding approach.
A byte-stream hash carries no semantics, so similar-content videos would not be nearby and it cannot serve semantic retrieval.
Follower count is creator popularity, not the video's content semantics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把图像帧切块后用自注意力编码成向量的模型,用于提取视频画面语义。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A vision transformer splits image frames into patches and encodes them with self-attention into vectors, extracting visual semantics.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时利用视觉、音频、文本多种模态生成统一的内容表征。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multimodal means combining vision, audio, and text modalities into one unified content representation.

scenario: 新视频靠内容嵌入进了候选集,但内容嵌入比协同过滤嵌入个性化更弱;随着它慢慢积累观看/分享,你想让推荐越来越个性化。
scenario_en: A new video entered via content embeddings, but those are less personalized than CF embeddings; as it accrues watches/shares you want recs to grow more personalized.
q: 该怎么随互动积累调整内容 vs 协同信号的权重？
q_en: How should you shift weight between content and collaborative signals as interactions accrue?
why: 做嵌入 warm-up:互动少时以内容嵌入为主(能推但个性化弱),随互动累积逐步把权重从内容转向协同过滤嵌入(更个性化)。混合比例可设成总曝光次数的函数——低于阈值内容主导,越过阈值协同接管。
why_en: Do embedding warm-up: with few interactions lean on content embeddings (recommendable but weakly personalized), then gradually shift weight from content to collaborative embeddings (more personalized) as interactions accrue, with the blend ratio a function of total impression count.
tradeoff: 内容嵌入(冷启段可推、个性化弱) vs 协同嵌入(需互动、个性化强);按曝光量渐变混合
options: 永远只用内容嵌入,即使积累了大量互动
嵌入 warm-up:少互动时内容主导,随互动积累按曝光量渐变把权重转向协同过滤嵌入
一有第一条互动就立刻 100% 切到协同过滤
两种嵌入永远各占 50%,不随互动变化
options_en: Use only content embeddings forever, even after many interactions.
Embedding warm-up: content dominates with few interactions, then shift weight toward CF embeddings by impression count as interactions accrue.
Switch 100% to collaborative filtering the instant the first interaction arrives.
Keep the two embeddings at a fixed 50/50 regardless of interactions.
whenOtherWins: 若视频始终没什么互动(长尾冷门),内容嵌入应长期主导,因为协同信号一直不足以支撑个性化。
whenOtherWins_en: If a video never accrues much interaction (long-tail obscure), content embeddings should keep dominating, since collaborative signal stays too sparse to personalize.
optionExplanations: 积累了互动还只用内容嵌入,白白浪费更个性化的协同信号,推荐停在弱个性化。
对;按曝光量从内容渐变到协同,是嵌入 warm-up 的标准做法,平滑接管。
第一条互动就全切协同,信号太少会极不稳定、噪声大。
固定 50/50 忽略互动多少,冷启段和成熟段都不最优。
optionExplanations_en: Sticking to content embeddings after interactions accrue wastes the more personalized collaborative signal, leaving recs weakly personalized.
Correct — shifting from content to collaborative by impression count is the standard embedding warm-up, a smooth handover.
Switching fully to collaborative on the first interaction is highly unstable and noisy with too little signal.
A fixed 50/50 ignores interaction volume and is optimal neither in cold start nor at maturity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 随互动积累把推荐权重从内容嵌入逐步转向协同过滤嵌入的渐变策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding warm-up gradually shifts recommendation weight from content to collaborative-filtering embeddings as interactions accrue.

termDefinitions.meaning: 视频被展示给用户一次;累计曝光量常作混合比例的自变量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An impression is one showing of a video to a user; cumulative impression count often drives the blend ratio.

scenario: 把整个目录嵌入:每个向量 256 维、每维 4 字节 float,目录约 10 亿视频。
scenario_en: Embedding the whole catalog: each vector is 256-dim, 4 bytes per float, catalog about 1 billion videos.
q: 这个规模的原始嵌入大约占多少存储，这对系统设计意味着什么？
q_en: Roughly how much storage do these raw embeddings take, and what does that imply?
why: 算法:256 维 × 4 字节 = 1KB/向量;× 10 亿视频 ≈ 1TB 原始嵌入。1TB 一台机器内存装不下,所以 ANN 索引必须分片(sharding)+副本(replication),这也是为什么检索层要跨几十台机器,并考虑 PQ 压缩降内存。
why_en: Compute: 256 dims x 4 bytes = 1KB per vector, times 1 billion videos is about 1TB of raw embeddings, which one machine's memory cannot hold, so the ANN index must be sharded plus replicated across dozens of machines, motivating PQ compression.
options: 约 1GB,单机内存轻松装下
约 1TB(256×4B×10 亿):单机内存装不下,ANN 索引必须分片+副本,并考虑压缩降内存
约 1PB,只能存磁盘、无法做内存检索
约 1MB,可忽略不计
options_en: About 1GB, easily fits one machine's memory.
About 1TB (256x4B x 1B): one machine cannot hold it, so the ANN index must be sharded + replicated and consider compression.
About 1PB, storable only on disk with no in-memory retrieval.
About 1MB, negligible.

termDefinitions.meaning: 向量的维数,视频推荐常用 128-256 维;维度×字节×数量 = 存储量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding dimension is the vector's length, commonly 128-256 for video recsys; dims x bytes x count gives storage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 乘积量化:把向量切段并各自量化压缩,大幅降低内存,牺牲少量精度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PQ (Product Quantization) splits a vector into segments and quantizes each to shrink memory greatly at slight accuracy cost.

scenario: 要给整个 10 亿视频目录批量算内容嵌入,这个作业会跑很久、还可能中途失败。
scenario_en: You batch-compute content embeddings for the whole 1-billion-video catalog, a long job that may fail midway.
q: 这个 catalog 嵌入管线该怎么设计？
q_en: How should the catalog-embedding pipeline be designed?
why: 用分布式 GPU 集群批量跑内容模型(或训练好的双塔编码器),并配编排来处理失败/重试(否则跑一半挂了要从头)。产出的向量装入 HNSW/IVF 等 ANN 索引,分片+副本存储。这是离线重活,不在 serving 关键路径上。
why_en: Run the content model (or a trained two-tower encoder) in batch on a distributed GPU cluster with orchestration for failures/retries (or a mid-run crash restarts from scratch), then load the vectors into HNSW/IVF ANN indexes, sharded and replicated — an offline heavy job off the serving critical path.
tradeoff: 离线分布式批量+编排重试(可扩展、抗失败) vs 单机一次性跑(慢、一挂全废)
options: 在 serving 请求时对每个视频实时算嵌入
分布式 GPU 集群批量跑内容模型,配失败重试编排,产出向量装入分片+副本的 ANN 索引
用单台 CPU 顺序跑完 10 亿视频
让用户设备各自算自己看到的视频嵌入
options_en: Compute each video's embedding in real time at serving request.
Batch-run the content model on a distributed GPU cluster with failure-retry orchestration, loading vectors into a sharded + replicated ANN index.
Run all 1 billion videos sequentially on a single CPU.
Have each user device compute embeddings for the videos it sees.
whenOtherWins: 若只是少量新上传视频要嵌入(增量),可用一个轻量近实时管线单独处理,不必每次都全量批跑。
whenOtherWins_en: For just a few newly uploaded videos (incremental), a lightweight near-real-time pipeline can handle them, without a full batch run each time.
optionExplanations: serving 时实时算 10 亿级嵌入会击穿延迟预算,嵌入本就该离线预计算。
对;分布式 GPU 批量+编排重试是全目录嵌入的标准工程,抗失败可扩展。
单 CPU 顺序跑 10 亿视频要跑到天荒地老,且一挂全废,不可行。
让用户设备算嵌入既不安全也算不动大模型,还无法共享索引。
optionExplanations_en: Computing billion-scale embeddings at serving blows the latency budget; embeddings should be precomputed offline.
Correct — distributed GPU batch with retry orchestration is the standard engineering for whole-catalog embedding, failure-resistant and scalable.
A single CPU sequentially over 1 billion videos takes forever and loses everything on a crash — infeasible.
Having user devices compute embeddings is insecure, cannot run big models, and cannot share an index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 调度分布式作业、处理失败与重试、跟踪进度的控制层,保证长作业能跑完。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Orchestration is the control layer scheduling distributed jobs, handling failures and retries, and tracking progress so long jobs finish.

scenario: 要把 10 亿视频向量装进 ANN 索引做毫秒级检索,在 HNSW 和 IVF+PQ 之间选。
scenario_en: Loading 1 billion video vectors into an ANN index for millisecond retrieval, choosing between HNSW and IVF+PQ.
q: HNSW 和 IVF+PQ 在内存与召回上的核心取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the core memory-vs-recall tradeoff between HNSW and IVF+PQ?
why: HNSW 是多层近邻图,召回强,但要在内存里存全精度向量、内存开销大;IVF+PQ 用 Voronoi 分桶+乘积量化压缩向量,内存大幅下降,代价是可调的召回损失。海量+内存紧就偏 IVF+PQ,召回优先就偏 HNSW。
why_en: HNSW is a multi-layer proximity graph with strong recall but stores full-precision vectors in memory (heavy), while IVF+PQ uses Voronoi bucketing plus product quantization to shrink memory dramatically at a tunable recall loss — favor IVF+PQ when memory-bound, HNSW when recall-first.
tradeoff: HNSW(召回强但内存大,存全精度) vs IVF+PQ(内存省但召回可调损失)
options: 两者内存和召回完全一样,只是名字不同
HNSW 召回强但内存大(存全精度);IVF+PQ 用分桶+量化大幅省内存,代价是可调召回损失
IVF+PQ 内存更大、召回也更高,全面优于 HNSW
HNSW 不占内存,IVF+PQ 只能存磁盘
options_en: Both have identical memory and recall, just different names.
HNSW has strong recall but heavy memory (full-precision); IVF+PQ uses bucketing + quantization to save memory at a tunable recall loss.
IVF+PQ uses more memory and higher recall, strictly better than HNSW.
HNSW uses no memory and IVF+PQ can only be disk-stored.
optionExplanations: 两者取舍不同:HNSW 吃内存换召回,IVF+PQ 压内存牺牲一点召回,不是一样。
对;全精度内存 vs 压缩省内存+可调召回损失,正是二者的核心取舍。
IVF+PQ 是压缩省内存的,不是更大内存更高召回,描述反了。
HNSW 恰恰内存开销大;IVF+PQ 也常驻内存检索,不是只能磁盘。
optionExplanations_en: Their tradeoffs differ: HNSW spends memory for recall, IVF+PQ compresses memory sacrificing some recall — not the same.
Correct — full-precision memory vs compressed memory with tunable recall loss is exactly the core tradeoff.
IVF+PQ compresses to save memory, not more memory and higher recall — reversed.
HNSW is memory-heavy, and IVF+PQ also retrieves in memory, not disk-only.

termDefinitions.meaning: 多层可导航近邻图 ANN 索引,召回强但内存里存全精度向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) is a multi-layer proximity-graph ANN index with strong recall but full-precision in-memory vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 倒排文件索引:先把向量分到 Voronoi 桶,查询只搜相近桶,常配 PQ 压缩。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF (Inverted File index) buckets vectors into Voronoi cells and searches only nearby cells, often paired with PQ compression.

scenario: 你重新训练了内容/双塔嵌入模型,准备上线新版嵌入。
scenario_en: You retrained the content/two-tower embedding model and are about to ship new embeddings.
q: 重训嵌入模型为什么会引出「整索引重建」这个 Staff+ 难题？
q_en: Why does retraining the embedding model raise the Staff+ whole-index-rebuild problem?
why: 嵌入模型一变,所有向量的坐标系都变了→每个视频的嵌入都得重算→整个 ANN 索引必须重建并原子切换。天真做法会出现「新旧嵌入混用/陈旧嵌入」的窗口:查询向量是新模型的、索引里还是旧向量,相似度就失真。
why_en: Change the embedding model and the whole vector space changes, so every video's embedding must be recomputed and the entire ANN index rebuilt and swapped atomically; a naive swap creates a mixed/stale-embedding window where the query is new-model but the index is old vectors, distorting similarity.
options: 只需更新变动过的少数视频嵌入,其余不受影响
模型变→向量坐标系全变→每个嵌入都要重算→整索引重建+原子切换;天真做法有新旧混用/陈旧窗口
重训模型不影响已有嵌入,索引无需动
只要把学习率调小,嵌入就不会变
options_en: Only the few changed videos' embeddings need updating; the rest are unaffected.
A model change shifts the whole vector space, so every embedding is recomputed, the whole index rebuilt and atomically swapped; a naive swap has a mixed/stale window.
Retraining does not affect existing embeddings, so the index needs no change.
Just lower the learning rate and embeddings won't change.
optionExplanations: 模型变会改变所有向量的坐标系,不是只影响少数视频,全都得重算。
对;新模型让整个嵌入空间改变,必须整索引重建并原子切换,否则出现失真窗口。
重训恰恰改变所有嵌入,索引不动会让新查询对旧向量,相似度失真。
调学习率改变的是训练动态,只要模型更新了嵌入就会变,不能靠它避免。
optionExplanations_en: A model change shifts every vector's coordinate system, not just a few videos — all must be recomputed.
Correct — a new model changes the whole embedding space, requiring a full rebuild and atomic swap or a distorting window appears.
Retraining precisely changes all embeddings; leaving the index untouched makes new queries hit old vectors, distorting similarity.
Learning rate changes training dynamics; once the model updates, embeddings change, so it cannot avoid this.

termDefinitions.meaning: 嵌入模型更新后重算全部向量并重建 ANN 索引,需原子切换避免新旧混用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An index rebuild recomputes all vectors after an embedding-model update and rebuilds the ANN index, swapped atomically to avoid mixing versions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次性把流量从旧索引切到新索引,不出现半新半旧的中间态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An atomic swap flips traffic from the old index to the new one at once, with no half-new-half-old intermediate state.

scenario: 整个 ANN 索引要换新版嵌入,但换的过程中不能让线上检索出现失真或宕机。
scenario_en: The whole ANN index must switch to new embeddings, but online retrieval must not distort or go down during the switch.
q: 怎么安全地完成整索引切换？
q_en: How do you safely complete the whole-index switch?
why: 用蓝绿部署:在旁边并行构建新索引(green),先验证 recall@K 与延迟 SLA 达标,再原子切换流量路由;旧索引(blue)保留可即时回滚。这样切换是瞬时且已验证的,避免陈旧嵌入窗口。
why_en: Use blue-green deployment: build the new index (green) in parallel, validate recall@K and latency SLA, then atomically switch the traffic router while keeping the old index (blue) for instant rollback, making the switch instant and validated with no stale-embedding window.
tradeoff: 蓝绿部署(并行构建+验证后原子切,安全但要双份资源) vs 原地更新(省资源但有失真/宕机窗口)
options: 直接在旧索引上原地覆盖写新向量,边写边服务
蓝绿部署:并行构建新索引,验证 recall@K/延迟达标后原子切流量,旧索引留作回滚
停机几小时,离线重建后再开服务
让新旧索引各服务一半用户,永久共存
options_en: Overwrite new vectors in place on the old index while serving.
Blue-green deployment: build the new index in parallel, validate recall@K/latency, atomically switch traffic, keep the old index for rollback.
Take hours of downtime, rebuild offline, then reopen.
Let old and new indexes each serve half the users permanently.
whenOtherWins: 若索引小、重建极快且能容忍短暂窗口,增量插入或原地更新更省资源,不必开双份蓝绿。
whenOtherWins_en: If the index is small, rebuilds fast, and a brief window is tolerable, incremental insertion or in-place update saves resources without doubling for blue-green.
optionExplanations: 原地边写边服务会出现半新半旧的失真窗口,查询相似度不可靠。
对;并行构建+验证达标+原子切+可回滚,是零窗口安全切换的标准做法。
停机几小时违背可用性,billion 级重建可能长达数小时到数天,不可接受。
新旧永久共存会让同一用户命中不同坐标系,相似度不可比,是错的。
optionExplanations_en: In-place overwrite while serving creates a half-new-half-old distortion window with unreliable similarity.
Correct — parallel build, validate, atomic swap, and rollback is the standard zero-window safe switch.
Hours of downtime violates availability, and billion-scale rebuilds can take hours to days — unacceptable.
Permanent coexistence makes one user hit different coordinate systems with incomparable similarity — wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 并行维护旧(blue)新(green)两套,新套验证后原子切流量,旧套留作即时回滚。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Blue-green deployment keeps old (blue) and new (green) in parallel, atomically switching traffic after validating green, with blue kept for instant rollback.

scenario: 全目录重嵌入需要巨量 GPU,峰值算力吃不消;但高流量视频的新鲜嵌入最要紧。
scenario_en: Re-embedding the whole catalog needs enormous GPU and the peak is unaffordable, but high-traffic videos' fresh embeddings matter most.
q: 怎么在不打满 GPU 峰值的前提下推进重嵌入？
q_en: How do you progress re-embedding without maxing GPU peak?
why: 增量重嵌入:先重算高流量视频(它们影响最大用户量),长尾在更长窗口里慢慢回填。这样把 GPU 需求摊平、削峰,同时最快让最要紧的嵌入更新到位。
why_en: Incremental re-embedding: recompute high-traffic videos first (they affect the most users) and backfill the long tail over a longer window, flattening peak GPU demand while updating the most important embeddings fastest.
tradeoff: 增量重嵌入(削峰、先高流量) vs 一次性全量重嵌入(峰值 GPU 打满、快但贵)
options: 一次性把全目录同时重嵌入,峰值 GPU 拉满
增量重嵌入:先重算高流量视频,长尾在更长窗口回填,削平 GPU 峰值
干脆不重嵌入,一直用旧向量
只重嵌入长尾,高流量视频保持旧向量
options_en: Re-embed the whole catalog at once, maxing peak GPU.
Incremental re-embedding: recompute high-traffic videos first, backfill the long tail over a longer window, flattening peak GPU.
Skip re-embedding and keep old vectors forever.
Re-embed only the long tail, leaving high-traffic videos on old vectors.
whenOtherWins: 若有充足 GPU 且要求全目录同版本一致(如配合一次原子蓝绿切换),一次性全量重嵌入反而更简单、无版本混杂。
whenOtherWins_en: With ample GPU and a need for whole-catalog version consistency (paired with one atomic blue-green swap), a one-shot full re-embed is simpler with no version mixing.
optionExplanations: 一次性全量会把 GPU 峰值打满,资源吃不消,正是要规避的。
对;先高流量后长尾的增量策略削平峰值,又优先更新影响最大的嵌入。
不重嵌入就享受不到新模型的提升,嵌入越来越陈旧。
只重长尾把最影响用户的高流量视频晾在旧向量上,优先级搞反了。
optionExplanations_en: A one-shot full re-embed maxes peak GPU beyond capacity, exactly what to avoid.
Correct — high-traffic-first, long-tail-later incremental flattens the peak while prioritizing the most impactful embeddings.
Not re-embedding forgoes the new model's gains and lets embeddings grow stale.
Re-embedding only the long tail leaves the most user-impactful high-traffic videos on old vectors — priorities reversed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按流量优先级分批重算嵌入(先高流量后长尾),削平峰值 GPU 需求。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Incremental re-embedding recomputes embeddings in traffic-priority batches (high-traffic first, long tail later) to flatten peak GPU demand.

scenario: 重嵌入过渡期里,一部分视频已是新版嵌入、一部分还是旧版,查询要能对上正确的版本。
scenario_en: During the re-embed transition, some videos are on new embeddings and some on old, and queries must match the correct version.
q: 过渡期怎么保证查询用对嵌入版本？
q_en: How do you ensure queries use the right embedding version during transition?
why: 嵌入版本化:同时存多个版本,给每条查询按当前过渡策略路由到对应版本的向量比对,避免拿新模型的查询向量去比旧模型的库向量(坐标系不同、相似度失真)。过渡完成后再收敛到单一版本。
why_en: Embedding versioning: store multiple versions and route each query to the matching version's vectors during transition, avoiding comparing a new-model query vector against old-model index vectors (different spaces, distorted similarity), then converge to one version afterward.
tradeoff: 嵌入版本化(过渡期不失真但要多存/路由) vs 单版本硬切(简单但过渡期易混坐标系)
options: 过渡期随便用哪版都行,反正差不多
嵌入版本化:存多版本,按过渡策略把查询路由到对应版本的向量比对,避免跨坐标系失真
过渡期直接停服务,等全切完再开
把新旧向量直接平均成一个中间向量
options_en: Any version is fine during transition; they're roughly the same.
Embedding versioning: store multiple versions and route each query to the matching version's vectors, avoiding cross-space distortion.
Shut down service during transition until fully switched.
Average old and new vectors into one intermediate vector.
whenOtherWins: 若能用蓝绿一次性原子切换、过渡窗口趋近于零,就无需长期维护多版本路由的复杂度。
whenOtherWins_en: If a blue-green atomic swap makes the transition window near-zero, you avoid the complexity of maintaining multi-version routing.
optionExplanations: 新旧版本坐标系不同,混用会让相似度失真,不是差不多。
对;版本化+按版本路由保证查询与库向量同坐标系,过渡期不失真。
停服务违背可用性,billion 级过渡可能很长,不可接受。
平均新旧向量得到的是无意义的混合坐标,相似度更乱,是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Old and new versions live in different spaces, so mixing distorts similarity — not roughly the same.
Correct — versioning plus version-aware routing keeps query and index vectors in the same space, undistorted during transition.
Shutting down violates availability, and a billion-scale transition can be long — unacceptable.
Averaging old and new gives a meaningless mixed space with worse similarity — wrong.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同时保存多个嵌入模型版本的向量,过渡期按版本路由查询,避免跨坐标系比对。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding versioning stores vectors from multiple embedding-model versions and routes queries by version during transition to avoid cross-space comparison.

scenario: 在 billion 级目录上做一次完整索引重建,大约要跑数小时到数天。
scenario_en: A full index rebuild on a billion-scale catalog takes roughly hours to days.
q: 「重建要数小时到数天」这个事实直接约束了什么设计决策？
q_en: What design decision does 'rebuild takes hours to days' directly constrain?
why: 它直接约束嵌入模型的更新频率:重建这么慢,你就不可能每小时换一版嵌入模型,更新节奏被重建耗时框死。所以要么接受较低的模型迭代频率,要么上增量重嵌入/蓝绿等手段来摊平这个成本。
why_en: It directly constrains how often you can update the embedding model: with rebuilds this slow you cannot swap the model hourly, so cadence is bounded by rebuild time — accept a lower iteration frequency or use incremental re-embedding/blue-green to amortize it.
options: 约束了视频的清晰度设置
约束嵌入模型的更新频率:重建太慢→不能高频换模型;需增量/蓝绿摊平成本
约束了用户界面刷新率
约束了数据库主键类型
options_en: Constrains the video resolution setting.
Constrains embedding-model update frequency: slow rebuilds mean you cannot swap the model often; use incremental/blue-green to amortize.
Constrains the UI refresh rate.
Constrains the database primary-key type.

termDefinitions.meaning: 整索引重建耗时(数小时到数天)决定嵌入模型能多频繁更新的上限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Rebuild cadence — hours to days for a full rebuild — caps how frequently the embedding model can be updated.

q: 把新视频从上传到进入检索、再逐步个性化的流程排好:
q_en: Order the flow of a new video from upload to retrieval to gradual personalization:
steps: 对新视频跑内容模型(视觉/音频/文本)生成内容嵌入
用内容嵌入与用户偏好嵌入做 ANN 相似度,超阈值进候选集
视频获得真实观看/分享,积累互动信号
按曝光量做 embedding warm-up,权重从内容渐移到协同过滤
why: 冷启动闭环:先用内容模型给零互动新视频造语义嵌入→ANN 相似度把它 bootstrap 进候选集→拿到曝光后积累真实互动→再按曝光量 warm-up 把权重从内容转向更个性化的协同过滤嵌入。每一步解锁下一步。
why_en: Cold-start loop: content model makes a semantic embedding for the zero-interaction video, ANN similarity bootstraps it into the set, exposure accrues real interactions, then impression-count warm-up shifts weight from content to more personalized collaborative embeddings.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  E["生成内容嵌入"] --> A["ANN 相似度进候选集"]
  A --> I["积累真实互动"]
  I --> W["warm-up 内容→协同"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 用不依赖互动的信号(内容嵌入)让新物品先获得曝光,从而开始积累互动。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bootstrap uses interaction-free signals (content embeddings) to get a new item initial exposure so it can start accruing interactions.

scenario: 同一个视频既能算内容嵌入(从画面/音频/文本),也能在积累互动后算协同过滤嵌入(从共现行为)。
scenario_en: The same video can have a content embedding (from frames/audio/text) and, once interactions accrue, a collaborative-filtering embedding (from co-occurrence behavior).
q: 内容嵌入和协同过滤嵌入的关键差别，决定了它们各自的用武之地？
q_en: What key difference between content and collaborative embeddings decides where each shines?
why: 内容嵌入来自视频本身内容、零互动就能算,但个性化弱(只知道内容像不像);协同过滤嵌入来自用户互动共现、更个性化(知道什么样的人爱看),但需要足够互动才准。所以冷启用内容、成熟后转协同。
why_en: Content embeddings come from the video's own content and exist at zero interactions but are weakly personalized (only content similarity), while CF embeddings come from interaction co-occurrence and are more personalized (who likes it) but need enough interactions — so cold start uses content, maturity uses CF.
tradeoff: 内容嵌入(零互动可用、个性化弱) vs 协同过滤嵌入(需互动、个性化强)
options: 内容嵌入需要大量互动,协同过滤嵌入零互动就能算
